entries.name: store_extension
entries.statement:
∀ (fs fs' fs'' : List[Cl]) (tclss tclss' tclss'' : List[(Tab_t, List[V_ref])])
  (bss bss' bss'' : List[(Limit_t, List[Byte])]) (gs gs' gs'' : List[Global])
  (es es' es'' : List[(T_ref, List[V_ref])]) (ds ds' dss'' : List[List[Byte]])
if
  1. fs == fs'
  2. ALL2(tab_extension, tclss, tclss')
  3. ALL2(mem_extension, bss, bss')
  4. ALL2(global_extension, gs, gs')
  5. ALL2(elem_extension, es, es')
  6. ALL2(data_extension, ds, ds')
then
  store_extension(Wstore(fs, tclss, bss, gs, es, ds), Wstore(APPEND(fs', fs''), APPEND(tclss', tclss''), APPEND(bss', bss''), APPEND(gs', gs''), APPEND(es', es''), APPEND(ds', dss'')))

entries.name: inst_typing
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Wstore) (tbs ms gs es ds fs : List[Num]) (ts tfs : List[Tf])
  (tgs : List[Tg]) (elems_t : List[T_ref]) (datas_t : List[Unit])
  (tabs_t : List[Tab_t]) (mems_t : List[Limit_t])
if
  1. ALL2(funci_agree(s_funcs(s)), fs, tfs)
  2. ALL2(globi_agree(s_globs(s)), gs, tgs)
  3. ALL2(tabi_agree(s_tabs(s)), tbs, tabs_t)
  4. ALL2(memi_agree(s_mems(s)), ms, mems_t)
  5. ALL2(elemi_agree(s, s_elems(s)), es, elems_t)
  6. ALL2(datai_agree(s_datas(s)), ds, datas_t)
then
  inst_typing(s, Inst(ts, fs, tbs, ms, gs, es, ds), T_context(ts, tfs, tgs, elems_t, datas_t, tabs_t, mems_t, NIL, NIL, NONE, upt(0, LENGTH(fs))))

  4. !(n_zeros(ts) == NONE)
then
  cl_typing(s, Func_native(i, tf, ts, es), Tf(t1s, t2s))

  2. Lfilled(i, lholed, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Br(i))]), LI)
then

∀ (n : W32) (i : Num)

then
  reduce_simple([Basic(EConstNum(ConstInt32(n))), Basic(Br_if(i))], [Basic(Br(i))])

if
  1. LENGTH(is_) > val(c)
then
  reduce_simple([Basic(EConstNum(ConstInt32(c))), Basic(Br_table(is_, i))], [Basic(Br(EL(val(c), is_)))])

∀ (c : W32) (is_ : List[Num]) (i : Num)
if
  1. LENGTH(is_) <= val(c)
then
  reduce_simple([Basic(EConstNum(ConstInt32(c))), Basic(Br_table(is_, i))], [Basic(Br(i))])

  reduce_simple([Frame(n, f, MAP(v_to_e, vs))], MAP(v_to_e, vs))

∀ (n : Num) (f : Wframe), reduce_simple([Frame(n, f, [Trap])], [Trap])

  (vs : List[Value])
if
  1. LENGTH(vs) == n
  2. Lfilled(j, lholed, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Return)]), es)

entries.name: is_val_cases

∀ (e : Einstr),
  is_val(e) == ((∃ x : V_num, e == Basic(EConstNum(x))) || (∃ y : V_vec, e == Basic(EConstVec(y))) || (∃ r : V_ref, e == Ref(r)))

entries.name: is_val_basic

  is_val(Basic(b)) == ((∃ x : V_num, b == EConstNum(x)) || (∃ y : V_vec, b == EConstVec(y)))

entries.name: is_val_clauses
entries.statement:
∀ x : V_num, is_val(Basic(EConstNum(x)))
&& ∀ y : V_vec, is_val(Basic(EConstVec(y)))
&& ∀ r : V_ref, is_val(Ref(r))
&& !is_val(Trap)
&& ∀ i : Num, !is_val(Invoke(i))
&& ∀ n : Num, ∀ es : List[Einstr], ∀ les : List[Einstr], !is_val(Label(n, es, les))
&& ∀ n : Num, ∀ f : Wframe, ∀ es : List[Einstr], !is_val(Frame(n, f, es))
&& ∀ v : Value, is_val(v_to_e(v))

entries.name: map_v_to_e_cons

  (CONS(h, t) == MAP(v_to_e, vs)) == (∃ v : Value, ∃ vs2 : List[Value], vs == CONS(v, vs2) && h == v_to_e(v) && t == MAP(v_to_e, vs2))

entries.name: vals_map

entries.name: all_vals_map
entries.statement: ∀ (vs : List[Value]), ALL(is_val, MAP(v_to_e, vs))

entries.name: lfill_nil

entries.name: lfilled_rec

entries.name: lfilled_imp

entries.name: nil_eq_append

entries.name: append_split

  4. last_redex(e) || trap_top(e)
then
  rest == NIL
  && ∃ suf : List[Einstr], cs == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), suf) && e == APPEND(suf, [x])

entries.name: step_basic_lrec
entries.statement:
∀ (cs e0 rest e : List[Einstr]) (x : Einstr) (vs : List[Value]) (n : Num)
  (l : Lholed)
if
  1. APPEND(cs, [x]) == APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), CONS(Label(n, e0, lfill(l, e)), rest))
  2. ALL(is_val, cs)
  3. ∀ n2 : Num, ∀ e2 : List[Einstr], ∀ li : List[Einstr], !(x == Label(n2, e2, li))
then
  false

entries.name: step_basic
entries.statement:
∀ (s s' : Wstore) (f f' : Wframe) (cs les' : List[Einstr]) (x : Einstr)
if
  1. reduce(s, f, APPEND(cs, [x]), s', f', les')
  2. ALL(is_val, cs)
  3. !(x == Trap)
  4. ∀ n : Num, ∀ e0 : List[Einstr], ∀ li : List[Einstr], !(x == Label(n, e0, li))
then
  ∃ (pre suf e' : List[Einstr]),
    cs == APPEND(pre, suf)
    && les' == APPEND(pre, e')
    && reduce_base(s, f, APPEND(suf, [x]), s', f', e')

entries.name: map_v_to_e_eq_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (vs : List[Value]) (h : Einstr) (t : List[Einstr]),
  (MAP(v_to_e, vs) == CONS(h, t)) == (∃ v : Value, ∃ vs2 : List[Value], vs == CONS(v, vs2) && h == v_to_e(v) && t == MAP(v_to_e, vs2))

entries.name: eq_v_to_e
entries.statement:
∀ (e : Einstr) (v : Value),
  (e == v_to_e(v)) == ((∃ x : V_num, v == V_num(x) && e == Basic(EConstNum(x))) || (∃ y : V_vec, v == V_vec(y) && e == Basic(EConstVec(y))) || (∃ r : V_ref, v == V_ref(r) && e == Ref(r)))

entries.name: lfilled_trap_iff
entries.statement: ∀ (es : List[Einstr]), (∃ lh : Lholed, Lfilled(0, lh, [Trap], es)) == trap_top(es)
